contracts: process_hook.c owns the generated hook-entry machine-code layout
Process_BuildHookEntry is the only creator for hook entries that Process_DisableHookEntry may rewrite
A generated hook entry is identified by HOOK_TRAMP_CODE_TO_TRAMP_HEAD and tramp eyecatcher equals tzuk
Disable logic returns without patching if the hook-entry value is null or does not identify a Sandboxie trampoline
The disable patch keeps the original schema by changing test eax,eax to xor eax,eax and hotpatching the entry prefix to jump to that modified test
runtime_gate: Windows driver build plus XP-hook compatibility smoke on supported legacy targets or a controlled test harness that creates a hook entry, disables it, and verifies it routes to the original procedure. A negative test should call the disable path with zero and a non-Sandboxie trampoline-shaped address without mutating code.
